Pedal Power x Country Boy Community Bike Ride is a social group ride in Lexington, KY. It meets 2nd and 4th Wednesdays; meet 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm, starting at Country Boy Brewing. Expect about 8–10 miles, social, no-drop.

About the Pedal Power x Country Boy Community Bike Ride group ride

A casual loop around town from Country Boy Brewing, then back for the shop's happy hour. Nobody gets left behind. Cancelled if it rains.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
